color.$description: Colours that do not vary by theme. The first four are lifted from the :root block of port-manifest §8.5; the last two are documented additions the semantic layers need.

knob-fill.$description: Toggle knob fill — white in both themes.

ring-inset.$description: Inner highlight ring on accent-filled controls.

on-err.$description: ADDED. v1 never rendered a solid error fill (.btn--danger is a 9% tint with --err-strong text), but shadcn's destructive variant and Material 3's onError both require a foreground for a solid --err surface.

on-accent-2.$description: ADDED. Foreground on the light --accent-2 ramp step. Required by Material 3 onPrimaryContainer / onTertiary; equals the light theme's --text so the ink is one we already ship.

alpha-tint.$description: The tint alpha v1 uses for status-coloured containers (.btn--danger hover is color-mix(--err 16%)). Material 3's errorContainer is derived from it.
